items.name: button
items.title: Irina Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-button>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-vfx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-button>Confirm</irina-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-vfx

items.name: toggle

items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-vfx/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-progress label="Loading"></irina-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1.
